metadata.name: ReplacementCard
metadata.description: Use this API to replace a card by marking it  Lost/Stolen/Damage/Other/Re-Issue/Personalize and providing a replacement card by generating a new card or using a preprinted card from inventory.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account Number of the cardholder. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 2000000000000396893 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: Reason
request_fields.description: Reason for  card replacement Valid  values: 1 = Stolen 2 = Lost 3 = Damage 4 = Other 5 = Reissue 6 = Personalize 11 = Issue Physical Card Example : 2 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: DecisionFlag
request_fields.description: Used for performing various operations when respective flag values defined below are passed. Valid values: 0 = Do not Generate new Embossing 1 = Generate New Embossing Note: When 'Reason' = 5 (Reissue) then Value of DecisionFlag would be '0' Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: CardFee
request_fields.description: Note :- Even if the user provides the tag value '1 = fee should be charged,' this tag will not be used to charge the fee. The fee needs to be charged separately.

request_fields.name: DeliveryMechanism
request_fields.description: Description:Shipment delivery mechanism. By Default Setting must be for standard Delivery Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 0 = Standard , 1 = Priority, 2 = Overnight 3 = USPS Mail (First Class) 4 = FedEx Economy 5 = 2nd business day Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: CardType
request_fields.description: Type of card Valid Values : 0 = Card from Shelf 1 = Print New Card Condition: Required, if value of DecisionFlag tag is 1

request_fields.name: NewCardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of New/Personalized card. Ex: *********1234567[For Compliance masked BIN and Extended BIN] Valid values are  0-9 Clear Card Number Condition: NewCardNumber is required, if value of CardType tag is 0. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: NameOnCard
request_fields.description: Name to be Embossed on Card Valid values are A-Z, a-z, 0-9. Example: Hudson M Charles Condition: Mandatory when setup is Automatic/Mandatory Allowable Values: 28

request_fields.name: IsCardMasked
request_fields.description: This tag indicates whether CardNumber should be returned in masked form or in clear form. Valid Values: 0= Card Number without Masked in Resonse. 1= Card Number with Masked in Resonse. 2= No Card Number in Resonse. Condition:If No value is given then by default it returns Card Number with Masked in Response. Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: MemoFlag
request_fields.description: Possible Values: 1:Card Replacement on Legitimate Address 0:Card Replacement on Fraudulent Address Example : 1 Condition : when On Product, ReplaceWarningChangeAddr not null or zero and  DecisionFlag = 1 and ReissueReason = 1 or 2 Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: MemoDesc
request_fields.description: Description for Memo Condition : when On Product, ReplaceWarningChangeAddr not null or zero and  DecisionFlag = 1 and ReissueReason = 1 or 2 Allowable Values: 2000

request_fields.name: ShippingAddressFlag
request_fields.description: Decision flag to select Shipping Address Valid Values: '0'  Ship to Existing Address '1' Ship to Other Address Example: 1 Condition: When Reason = 1 or 2 and DecisionFlag = 0 it will become optional else mandatory Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: ShipToFirstName
request_fields.description: First Name  for Shipping address Valid Values: A-Z,a-z. Example: TestName Condition:It is mandatory when value of ShippingAddressFlag =1 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShipToMiddleName
request_fields.description: Middle Name  for Shipping address Valid Values: A-Z,a-z. Example: MName Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShipToLastName
request_fields.description: Last Name  for Shipping address Valid Values: A-Z,a-z. Example: LastName Condition:It is mandatory when value of ShippingAddressFlag =1 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShipToAddressLine1
request_fields.description: Address Line 1 for Shipping address Valid values:A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 Meca Way Condition:It is mandatory when value of ShippingAddressFlag =1 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShipToAddressLine2
request_fields.description: Address Line 2 for Shipping address Valid values:A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example:15 Penang Street Point Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShipToCity
request_fields.description: City for Shipping address Valid values:A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example:Norcross Condition:It is mandatory when value of ShippingAddressFlag =1 Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: ShipToState
request_fields.description: State for Shipping address Valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example:NY Condition:It is mandatory when value of ShippingAddressFlag =1 Refer Appendix Section: State Codes (US) Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: ShipToPostalCode
request_fields.description: ZIP code for Shipping address Valid values:A-Z, a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Condition:It is mandatory when value of ShippingAddressFlag =1 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ShipToCountry
request_fields.description: Country Code for Shipping address Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: US Condition:It is mandatory when value of ShippingAddressFlag =1 Refer Appendix Section : Country Code Values Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: HoldEmbossing
request_fields.description: Tag to decide physical card or virtual card by holding embossing file. Valid Values: 0 - No (Physical card) 1 - Yes (Virtual card) Note : field will be ignored with reason = 6 and 11

request_fields.name: PlasticCode
request_fields.description: Plastic Code Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 32 Allowable Values: 100

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: CardNumber
children.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Allowable Values: 16

children.name: ProxyNumber
children.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: PlasticCode
children.description: Plastic Code of Card Valid Values: a to z, A to Z, 0 to 9 Example:- Chicksaw Nation Grant Card - Clothing (50)
